name: Dream Nexus
permanentEffect: Systems that contain a nexus token are nebulas. Your ships' movement is not affected by these nebulae.

name: The Waking
window: At the end of the status phase
windowEffect: Any player with ships in a system that contains a nexus token may remove 1 token from 1 of those systems.

name: Incomprehensible Form
window: When 1 of your ships would be destroyed during space combat
windowEffect: You may instead remove 1 nexus token from the active system.

name: Fragmentation
window: After one of your non-fighter ships is destroyed
windowEffect: Capture 1 fighter from the supply.

name: Pieces of a Whole
window: At the start of space combat
windowEffect: You may return up to 2 captured fighters from your faction sheet to place that many fighters from your reinforcements in the active system.

name: Phoenix Rising
window: During setup
windowEffect: Place 12 infantry from the supply on your faction sheet. These units are captured. When your infantry are removed or destroyed, capture them. Game effects cannot prevent you from using this ability.

name: Forged in Fire
window: When you would place infantry from your reinforcements on the game board
windowEffect: You must produce those units instead. For each infantry you produce, return 1 captured infantry instead of spending resources.

name: Salvage Collectors
window: Once per combat you are participating in, after 1 or more ships are destroyed
windowEffect: Take a salvage card from your reinforcements of the same type as one of the destroyed units and place it face up in your play area.

name: Trade Secrets
window: During setup
windowEffect: Take the salvage cards and place them in your reinforcements. When a player negotiates a transaction, they may exchange salvage cards in their play area as part of that transaction.

name: Modifications
window: While a salvage card is in a player's play area
windowEffect: Those units gain the abilities and values on that card, if they do not already have them.

name: Planetary Reconfiguration
window: After you explore a planet
windowEffect: You may attach 1 of your designs from your reinforcements to that planet if it does not already have one. When you lose control of a planet with a design attached to it, return that card to your reinforcements. Designs do not count as attachments for the purposes of scoring objectives.

name: Perfect Architecture
window: When you explore a planet that has an attachment or contains 1 or more of your structures
windowEffect: You may draw 1 additional card; Choose 1 to resolve and discard the rest.

name: Neural Instruments
window: When any other player gains a technology, or exhausts a technology for its effect
windowEffect: Place 1 of that player's control tokens on your faction sheet. You cannot have more than 1 of each other player's control token on your faction sheet at a time.

name: Proxy Network
window: When you would research a non-faction technology
windowEffect: You must instead return 1 player's control token from your faction sheet to gain 1 of that player's non-faction technologies.

name: Cataclysm
window: Before gathering starting components
windowEffect: Put The Fracture into play. Then, choose 1 non-home, non-supernova anomaly and place 1 ingress token in that system.

name: Sacred Passage
permanentEffect: Apply +1 to the MOVE value of your ships that begin their movement in The Fracture or an anomaly.

name: Amaluun's Strength
permanentEffect: Apply +1 to the result of each of your units' combat rolls in The Fracture or in a system that contains an ingress token.

name: Valhöll's Call
window: After 1 or more of your infantry are destroyed during a round of ground combat
windowEffect: You may place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on another planet you control that contains 1 of your PDS units.

name: Reave
window: Once per turn, when you would win a ground combat on a planet you do not control
windowEffect: You may destroy each of your units on that planet to gain trade goods equal to that planet's resource value; that combat ends in a draw.

name: Bloodlust
window: Once per action, after you commit ground forces to a planet during a tactical action
windowEffect: If there are no units on that planet, you may resolve ground combat.

name: Harvest
window: After you gain control of a planet that has a technology specialty
windowEffect: Gain the corresponding harvest card and place it in your play area. Any time you control no planets that have a technology specialty that matches a harvest card in your play area, return that harvest card to your reinforcements.

name: Pseudomorphism
window: When you spend resources to research a technology
windowEffect: If you exhaust a planet to use its technology specialty to ignore any prerequisites, you may reduce the spent resources by that planet’s influence value.

name: Kinetic Morphology
window: After you activate a system
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card to apply +1 to the MOVE value of 1 of your ships during this tactical action.

name: Synaptic Grafting
window: After you exhaust a planet that has a technology specialty
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card to draw 1 action card.

name: Tachyonic Reversion
window: After you roll 1 or more dice during a round of combat
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card to reroll up to 2 of those dice.

name: Biomechanical Splicing
window: When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card to apply +1 to the total PRODUCTION value of your units and reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1.
